import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

# 读取数据
train_data = pd.read_csv(r'E:\Postgraduate\Code\SunnylnAgent\data\csv\bank_customer_churn_train.csv')
test_data = pd.read_csv(r'E:\Postgraduate\Code\SunnylnAgent\data\csv\bank_customer_churn_test.csv')

# 数据预处理
# 处理缺失值
train_data.fillna(train_data.mean(), inplace=True)
test_data.fillna(test_data.mean(), inplace=True)

# 编码分类变量
label_encoders = {}
for column in train_data.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns:
    le = LabelEncoder()
    train_data[column] = le.fit_transform(train_data[column])
    test_data[column] = le.transform(test_data[column])
    label_encoders[column] = le

# 划分特征和目标变量
X_train = train_data.drop(columns=['Exited'])
y_train = train_data['Exited']
X_test = test_data.drop(columns=['Exited'])
y_test = test_data['Exited']

# 训练随机森林模型
rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(random_state=42)
rf_model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# 在测试集上进行预测
y_pred = rf_model.predict(X_test)

# 计算 F1 分数
f1 = f1_score(y_test, y_pred, average='weighted')
print(f'Weighted F1 Score: {f1}')
